# Vendored: Viz.js

`viz-global.js` is `dist/viz-global.js` from the npm package `@viz-js/viz` 3.31.0,
unmodified. It's Graphviz 16.1.0 compiled to WebAssembly, with the WebAssembly module
inlined, so the docs site lays out its graphs in the browser from a page opened from
disk, with nothing fetched.

- Source: https://github.com/mdaines/viz-js (package tarball
  https://registry.npmjs.org/@viz-js/viz/-/viz-3.31.0.tgz, SHA-256
  7dc0189874849cca2fed7cbe88bf334cd0e6e012db16657794a812ad6f2b8c70)
- `viz-global.js` SHA-256:
  c9e0b310f9883910e01c66054b48b7ff4be3d8695141116635e72b0af152692e

- Expat, included in object code form: MIT. https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat

To upgrade, replace `viz-global.js` with the same file from a newer `@viz-js/viz`
release and update the version and checksums above.
